18059.d: The Mourner Headquarters, also known as the Mourner HQ, is the headquarters of the Prifddinas Death Guard, also known as the Mourners, in the north-eastern part of West Ardougne.

gt.heading: Access
gt.text:
Prior to Plague's End, as the Mourner Headquarters is fully under the control of the Mourners, who hide their elven identity and their activities from the humans of West Ardougne, only Mourners are allowed into the building. After partial completion of Mourning's End Part I, the player gains access to a set of full Mourner gear, which the player may use to pretend to be a Mourner and thus be permitted to access the Mourner headquarters. From then on until the completion of Plague's End, full Mourner gear is required to access the facility. 

The player must wear only Mourner gear to be allowed to enter the Mourner Headquarters, with limited exceptions for additional items that may also be worn. Any forbidden items can be kept in the inventory while entering. Attempting to enter while wearing full Mourner gear along with non-allowed items will result in a Mourner denying you entry, telling you that you should know better than to wear "non-regulation gear"-in other words, prohibited items, and you will be advised to take them off, in order to be allowed to enter. Attempting to enter while wearing only partial Mourner gear, or while wearing no Mourner gear, will cause the Mourners to recognise you as a non-Mourner, to ask who you are, and to ask you to go away. If you encounter a bug where Mourner's deny you entry with the message about "non-regulation gear" despite only wearing mourner equipment, unequip one item and then re-equip it. You should now be able to enter successfully.

Once inside the Mourner Headquarters, one can take off any Mourner gear and/or wear forbidden items without being thrown out. You will not be able to enter the trapdoor that leads to the basement without wearing full Mourner gear or while wearing any forbidden items; attempting to do so results in the message "The trapdoor is bolted on the other side." appearing in the chatbox. However, once inside the basement, you can again take off any Mourner gear and/or wear forbidden items without being thrown out. Attempting to talk to the Head Mourner while wearing full Mourner gear with any prohibited items, while wearing only partial Mourner gear, or while not wearing any Mourner gear will result in the Head Mourner recognising you as a human and calling for "Guards!", after which a Level 85 Mourner will come and attack you. 

Acceptable items

In addition to full Mourner gear, the following may also be worn without being forbidden access to the Mourner Headquarters building: 
• Any ring
• Enchanted gem

Forbidden items

The following may not be worn by those seeking to enter the Mourner Headquarters building, before the events of Plague's End: 
• Any armour
• Any boots
• Any cape
• Any gloves
• Any weapon
• Seal of passage

18072.d: Mourning's End Part II is the seventh and antepenultimate quest in the Elf (Prifddinas) quest series featuring the Temple of Light.

gt.heading: Entering the death altar
gt.text:
This section can be skipped if you already have a death talisman, omni-talisman, or a wicked hood fed with either. Just enter the death altar and skip to the next section.

Make sure you turn the mirror back towards the cyan door when teleporting away to prevent getting locked out and needing to do the last part of the puzzle again.

Thorgel's item list

After passing through the black door, the dwarf Thorgel is standing next to the entrance. When asking him how he got to the altar, he will reveal there is a passage from the Underground Pass created by him and his companions. Ask if he knows Klank, after which he will realise you are the one who slew Iban. Because of this, he agrees to trade a death talisman in return for some supplies.

He gives an item list with the supplies that he wants. Bring Thorgel each of the fifty items on the list, and he will give a death talisman. These items can be given to Thorgel in multiple trips; only a pack yak or a friend will make it possible to bring the items in one trip. Note: a pack yak can't be brought through the Underground Pass.

Make sure you turn the mirror with the red beam back towards the cyan door when teleporting away. Otherwise, you would get locked out of the entrance to the altar, requiring to go through the Underground Pass and enter the tunnel near the dwarf camp, or redo the final puzzle to return. It is not possible to teleport to the altar with a teleport tablet until the quest is complete.

18090.d: Movario's base was discovered during the While Guthix Sleeps quest.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The entrance to the base is in a ruined building on the Khazard Battlefield. The building can be entered by climbing the broken wall on the south side of the building. Players find the entrance by following a Broav in the While Guthix Sleeps quest. In the quest, the trapdoor to the base is hidden under a broken table. Once found for the first time, the trapdoor remains revealed and the Broav is not required any more.

The quickest way to get to the base is to use a Spirit tree to go to the battlefield. Other practical options are to use an Ardougne teleport, an Ourania Teleport from the Lunar spells, or fairy ring DJP to the Tower of Life. (Several of these methods are available only through quests, but it is virtually guaranteed the player will have completed the appropriate quests before starting While Guthix Sleeps.)

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text: Talk to a tool leprechaun at any farming patch (except at Harmony Island, the Wilderness herb patch, or Trollheim). Proceed through the dialogue, and select the chat option "Winkin's Farm". Next, select the option "Can you take me to Winkin's Farm?", to which the leprechaun responds by saying "Avach nimporto!" which teleports the player to the minigame site. There is a portal north-east of the farmhouse to return to the patch. Summoning familiars and pets cannot be brought into the minigame.
